title: Arrow Out 3D
description: Rotate and inspect a floating 3D cluster of directional arrow blocks, tapping unobstructed pieces to launch them free until the entire structure vanishes.
controls: Tap any unblocked arrow cube to slide it out in its pointing direction; drag to orbit the 3D puzzle cluster.

zh-CN.title: 3D 箭头消消乐
zh-CN.description: 旋转观察悬浮在空中的 3D 立体箭头方块阵，找准毫无遮挡的突破口逐个弹射清空，解压又烧脑。
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方无阻挡的箭头方块即可沿方向弹出，单指拖动可 360° 旋转视角观察结构。
